one_liner: Online payments, billing, invoicing and payouts platform.
auth_notes: Secret/restricted API keys (sk_/rk_) as Bearer-style auth; OAuth used for MCP and Stripe Apps/Connect; agent-tagged restricted keys supported.
access_notes: Free account; sandbox with test keys is self-serve; live keys after account activation.
api_notes: Very broad REST API (customers, charges, PaymentIntents, subscriptions, invoices, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, Tax, etc.) plus v2 APIs.

one_liner: Bank account linking, transactions, identity and payments data API.
auth_notes: client_id + secret sent in body or PLAID-CLIENT-ID / PLAID-SECRET headers; per-user access_tokens obtained via Plaid Link.
access_notes: Dashboard signup gives Sandbox credentials free; Production access must be requested via the Dashboard (approval criteria not documented).
api_notes: JSON-over-HTTPS POST API covering Auth, Transactions, Identity, Balance, Investments, Liabilities, Transfer, etc.

one_liner: Cryptocurrency exchange with spot, futures and account APIs.
auth_notes: API key in X-MBX-APIKEY header; signed endpoints need timestamp+signature (HMAC-SHA256, RSA or Ed25519).
access_notes: Create keys in account API Management; trading permission is off by default and must be enabled. Account (KYC) required.
api_notes: Spot REST docs reviewed; Binance also publishes WebSocket streams and derivatives APIs (not opened in detail).

one_liner: Payment product named Paygent Connect (hint says NMI-powered); could not be identified.
auth_notes: Only the underlying NMI gateway auth is documented (API keys); no Paygent Connect-specific docs found.
access_notes: NMI gateway access is via partner/merchant onboarding; Paygent Connect itself not found.
api_notes: Inferred from NMI REST/v5 payment API; unverified for Paygent Connect.
human_reason: No page found for 'Paygent Connect'; searches returned unrelated products (Paygent Japan, Paya, PayGentic). Cannot confirm any link to NMI.

one_liner: FX forensic audit API that scores bank/card FX rates against live mid-market.
auth_notes: Production key (ipx_live_...) sent as Authorization: Bearer in REST and MCP.
access_notes: Account signup is free with only 3 lifetime audits; API plans start at $99/mo (Developer, 100 audits, sandbox).
api_notes: Few endpoints: POST /v1/audit and score-config GET/PUT/DELETE; docs oddly list a Supabase function base URL.

one_liner: Intuit QuickBooks Online accounting software.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 only; no per-user API keys. Sandbox accepts localhost redirects; production needs public HTTPS redirect; refresh tokens last 100 days.
access_notes: Free Intuit developer account with sandbox company; production keys use the same portal (Intuit app assessment/terms not verified from primary docs).
api_notes: QBO Accounting REST API (customers, invoices, bills, payments, reports etc.); official MCP README lists many tools.

one_liner: Cloud accounting platform for small businesses.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (PKCE) and Custom Connections (client credentials for one org).
access_notes: Free Starter plan: 5 connections, 1,000 calls/day/org, no Journals endpoint; Core A$35/mo (50 connections); Plus+ needs App Certification.
api_notes: Accounting, payroll, assets, files, projects APIs; official XeroAPI MCP server uses accounting/payroll scopes.

one_liner: Corporate cards, expense, bill pay and travel platform.
auth_notes: User tokens created in dashboard (Developer settings) sent as Bearer; OAuth2 supported (MCP and OpenAPI spec).
access_notes: Requires an existing Brex customer account; an account/card admin must accept the Developer API agreement before creating tokens.
api_notes: Team API (users, departments, cards, locations, etc.) plus payments, transactions, expenses, budgets.
blocker: requires Brex customer account + admin agreement

one_liner: Corporate cards, expense management and bill pay platform.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0: client credentials for own business, authorization code for apps used by other businesses.
access_notes: Sandbox requested via sandbox-access page; apps registered in Ramp Developer Console; technology-partner application reviewed for production; vault scope needs support approval.
api_notes: Developer API v1 with OpenAPI spec; MCP exposes ~73 tools.
blocker: sandbox request and partner production review

one_liner: Private-market and VC/PE data and research platform.
auth_notes: Per third-party summaries, API key/token issued by PitchBook team after contract; official docs 403 to fetcher.
access_notes: API is a separate offering requiring standalone contract; no self-serve signup (secondary sources).
api_notes: Public API v2 reportedly documented on Postman; not verified.
human_reason: PitchBook help page returned 403 and MCP directory 403; details come from search snippets only (MCP URL/official status unverified).

one_liner: Google's AI notebook; Enterprise edition has a notebooks REST API.
auth_notes: Google user OAuth access token (e.g. gcloud auth print-access-token) as Bearer; user account, not service account.
access_notes: Needs Gemini/NotebookLM Enterprise license plus Cloud NotebookLM User role and Google Cloud project.
api_notes: v1alpha Pre-GA notebooks methods: create, get, list recent, batchDelete, share. No source/content/chat endpoints seen.

one_liner: AI meeting transcription and notes.
auth_notes: MCP uses OAuth; reported Enterprise-only Public API uses Bearer API keys (secondary sources).
access_notes: Public API reportedly Enterprise workspaces only; MCP available via user OAuth sign-in.
api_notes: Reported api.otter.ai/v1: conversations, channels, audio links, webhooks (unverified).
human_reason: help.otter.ai returned 403 and otter.ai/api/docs rendered no content; API plan gating comes from third-party sources only.

one_liner: AI meeting recorder with summaries and transcripts.
auth_notes: Per-user API key in X-Api-Key header; OAuth 2.0 for public apps registered in the Developer Portal.
access_notes: API key generated in User Settings > API Access; plan requirement not stated in docs.
api_notes: Base https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1: meetings, transcripts, summaries, webhooks; TS and Python SDKs.

one_liner: AI search engine over scientific papers.
auth_notes: REST uses Bearer API key from subscription page; MCP uses OAuth 2.1 auth code + PKCE with dynamic client registration.
access_notes: API keys are scoped to organization subscriptions (Teams/Enterprise); MCP free/anonymous tiers rate-limited.
api_notes: Search, paper detail, synthesis, Consensus Meter endpoints.
blocker: API needs org subscription; narrow API

one_liner: API for parsing, extracting and splitting documents for LLM pipelines.
auth_notes: Bearer API key (REDUCTO_API_KEY) created in docs/Studio.
access_notes: Free account signup; credit allotment not documented in pages read.
api_notes: Parse, extract, split, classify, edit endpoints; Python/Node/Go SDKs.

one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer from Cognition.
auth_notes: Service user credentials (cog_ prefix) or Personal Access Token as Bearer; legacy apk_ keys deprecated.
access_notes: Teams/standard orgs create service users; Enterprise API only for enterprise customers; requires Devin subscription.
api_notes: v3 org API (sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets) and enterprise API (analytics, audit logs, users, billing).

one_liner: AI image/video generation platform with 35+ models, exposed via CLI and MCP.
auth_notes: Browser sign-in (higgsfield auth login) and MCP account sign-in; no API keys.
access_notes: Uses platform credits from existing plan; free-tier details not stated.
api_notes: No public REST API documented on the page; integration is via CLI and MCP.
blocker: no documented public API; CLI/MCP only
human_reason: Only the CLI marketing page was found; no developer docs, REST API, or pricing/free-tier details verified.

one_liner: Local CLI that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF.
auth_notes: No authentication; local tool.
access_notes: Open-source npm package run locally; no hosted API.
api_notes: mmdc command and a Node.js run() API (not semver-covered).
blocker: local OSS CLI, not a hosted service

one_liner: TranscriptAPI: third-party REST API returning YouTube transcripts and search.
auth_notes: REST uses Bearer API key; MCP uses OAuth (Claude/ChatGPT) or API key. No Google/YouTube key needed.
access_notes: 100 free credits on signup, no card; paid from $5/mo for 1,000 credits.
api_notes: Transcript, YouTube search, channel search, channel/playlist listing, RSS tracking, handle resolve.

one_liner: AI meeting recorder with transcripts, notes and sales coaching.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token and Workspace Access Token as Bearer; OAuth2 for distributed apps; Public-Api-Version header required.
access_notes: Support article says PATs on all plans incl. Free; WATs need Business/Enterprise admin. Older docs reportedly said Enterprise-only (search snippet).
api_notes: Recordings, transcripts, AI notes, participants, tags, teams, uploads, webhooks; 300 req/min per token.
